input: Prepare me for a meeting with Gong (gong.io)

what_they_do.value: Gong is a revenue AI company. Its Revenue AI Operating System combines data, insights and workflows on top of the Gong Revenue Graph, specialized agents and trusted applications, to help revenue teams understand their teams and customers, automate revenue workflows and close deals with less effort.

priorities.priority: Agentic AI: moving from AI that gives insights to AI that takes action
priorities.evidence: Mission Big Dipper launched the Gong Revenue Harness, an 'agentic execution layer' that governs and orchestrates agents across the revenue cycle. It also launched no-code Custom Agents with scoped data access, audit trails and human oversight. At Celebrate '26 Gong launched Gong Activate, with always-on agents, plus Agent Builder for event-triggered agents. CEO Amit Bendov: 'For years, AI told you how to win. Now, AI wins deals for you.'

priorities.priority: Adding third-party data to the Revenue Graph (Gong Enrich)
priorities.evidence: Mission Callisto made Gong Enrich generally available. It adds third-party account and contact data to the Revenue Graph through 10 data partners, including ZoomInfo, Apollo, LeadIQ, Lusha and RocketReach. Customers set the order in which providers are searched and pay through Gong Credits. CPO Eilon Reshef: 'Every revenue decision is only as good as the context behind it.'

priorities.priority: Enterprise expansion and selling multiple products to each customer
priorities.evidence: ARR passed $500M, with growth above 55% YoY, the 10th straight quarter of acceleration. 50% of customers run multiple products. Gong added more $1M+ customers in the last two quarters than in the previous six combined. Half of the Fortune 10 are customers. Gong also cites Cisco with 18,000 licenses.

priorities.priority: Gong Assistant and analytics: Deep Mode, Dashboards, Data Studio
priorities.evidence: Deep Mode in Gong Assistant became generally available and produces grounded reports on complex strategic questions. Assistant is now embedded in Deal and Account Boards and can build Engage Flows from natural-language requests. Dashboards now span the full revenue lifecycle, with metrics defined once in Gong Data Studio.

priorities.priority: Scaling R&D for AI-native development, and AI data governance/security
priorities.evidence: Gong hired monday.com's engineering leader, Liron Shtraichman, as Chief R&D Officer to expand agentic capabilities across the Revenue Graph, Revenue Harness and Revenue Operating Surfaces. It also named Guy Havusha CISO, owning security, privacy, compliance and data governance for AI and agents.

challenges.challenge: Pressure from a consolidated Salesloft + Clari
challenges.evidence: Clari and Salesloft closed their merger on Dec 3, 2025 under CEO Steve Cox. The first integrated release came on Apr 15, 2026, and the combined company consolidated under the Salesloft brand on Sep 2, 2026. Salesloft now offers forecasting (Clari Forecast) that competes with Gong Forecast. Note: the source is a competitor-published comparison.

challenges.challenge: Buyer complaints about price, contract terms and recording issues
challenges.evidence: Vendr benchmark (updated Mar 2026): median Gong contract about $55.3K/yr. A platform fee surprises smaller teams, Engage and Forecast add-ons raise total cost 20-50%, and auto-renewals carry 5-10% increases. The most-cited G2 cons are call issues (119 mentions) and recording issues (77), from G2 data pulled Sep 21, 2026. Gong Engage has 152 reviews vs Salesloft's 2,983. Note: the source sells a competing product.

A secondary round via Nasdaq's private market ran at about $4.5B, versus the last official round at $7.25B. The article notes it was unclear whether employee options issued at higher valuations would be repriced. This is older than a year; ARR has grown sharply since.

recent_changes.headline: Liron Shtraichman appointed Chief R&D Officer; Guy Havusha named CISO
recent_changes.summary: Shtraichman (ex-monday.com, where she led the global engineering org's shift to AI-native engineering) will expand Gong's agentic capabilities. Havusha, previously VP Platform Security at Gong and Global CISO at monday.com, leads security, privacy, compliance and AI data governance.

recent_changes.headline: Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Revenue Action Orchestration (second year)
recent_changes.summary: One of 4 Leaders among 13 vendors. Positioned highest on Ability to Execute and furthest on Completeness of Vision.

recent_changes.headline: Celebrate '26: Gong Activate, Agent Builder, Deep Mode
recent_changes.summary: Gong Activate (always-on agents) is billed as the next generation of Revenue AI. Customer results cited: AT&T Business +54% rep productivity, Cisco 18K licenses with ~26% higher win rates, Experian +25% win rates.

recent_changes.headline: Mission Callisto: Gong Enrich sales-enrichment layer
recent_changes.summary: Gong Enrich is generally available with 10 data partners (Apollo, Findymail, Firmable, Kernel, LeadIQ, Lusha, RocketReach, Wiza, ZeroBounce, ZoomInfo), billed through Gong Credits.

key_people.name: Amit Bendov
key_people.title: Co-founder & CEO
key_people.recent: Oct 16, 2026: 'Gong created the Revenue AI category, we're leading it, and we're committed to leading it for years to come.' At Celebrate '26: 'Now, AI wins deals for you.'

key_people.name: Eilon Reshef
key_people.title: Co-founder & Chief Product Officer
key_people.recent: Spokesperson for Mission Callisto/Gong Enrich (Sep 30, 2026): 'Every revenue decision is only as good as the context behind it.' In June 2026: 'Every revenue leader has AI. Almost none of them are moving the number with it.'

key_people.name: Liron Shtraichman
key_people.title: Chief R&D Officer
key_people.recent: Joined Nov 4, 2026 from monday.com to expand agentic capabilities across the Revenue Graph and Revenue Harness.

key_people.name: Guy Havusha
key_people.title: Chief Information Security Officer
key_people.recent: Promoted Nov 4, 2026 to lead security, privacy, compliance and data governance for Gong's AI and agents.

talking_points: Gong Enrich launched with 10 third-party data partners and a configurable search order. How are you judging partner data quality and coverage, and where do gaps remain in the Revenue Graph (e.g., public web signals on accounts and contacts)?

Revenue Harness, Agent Builder and Activate push always-on agents that act on account signals. What external real-time data do those agents need that the Revenue Graph doesn't capture today, and how are you sourcing it?

With a new Chief R&D Officer focused on AI-native engineering and a new CISO owning AI data governance (Nov 2026), what are the build-vs-partner and data-compliance criteria for new data sources feeding the agents?
missing_fields: headcount (current; latest seen was ~1,300 as of 2025-11-17)
